Definition: of Chaldee origin (corresponding to H256); Clopas, an Israelite:--Cleophas.
BiblicalUsage: Clopas is an Israelite, the husband of Mary who stood by the cross. John 19:25 says there stood by the cross of Jesus his mother, and his mother's sister, Mary the wife of Cleophas, and Mary Magdalene.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Clopas is remembered by his wife's place at the cross: Mary stood there when the disciples had fled, and her husband's name stands with her.
